title: Climb the ranks, one fire at a time
lead: Every fire you put out gives points. Points raise your level. Every few levels you move up a rank, and the fires get a little harder.

what.legend: The hardest fires, for as long as you like

how.title: How you get points
how.lead: Every fire counts: the daily fire, the campaign and quick fires. You never lose points.
how.fire: Each fire you put out, more for a bigger board
how.noHints: Solved without a hint (daily fire and campaign)
how.streak: Playing the daily fire several days in a row
